expectations.text: The response suggests an early checkpoint such as an outline or framework before the full report
expectations.evidence: Provides “报告骨架，按‘USP 决策’倒推” with nine sections before promising “我按这个骨架一次写完。”

expectations.text: The suggestion is framed as the user's call, not imposed
expectations.evidence: “所以我先不给假报告，给你两个能立刻推进的东西” unilaterally substitutes inputs and an outline; the user is not offered a choice about this intermediate step.
